# Identification where runs part / 运行分开之处的辨识

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`identification-where-runs-part` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](identification-where-runs-part.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Wherever the runs of a process register one course, a record fixes it from 2N − 1 on with a bound of N configurations, as for determined laws. At a parting the next value is settled only when taken: a learner, whatever it is given, the world included, is right on at most one of the two runs.
>
> 凡一个过程的运行所识的是同一历程之处，配置数为 N 时，记录从 2N − 1 起确定它，与确定的律一样。在分开之处，下一个值只在被走时定下：学习者无论被给予什么（世界在内），至多在两个运行之一上对。

## Laws / 规律

1. Two runs part at a step where they register the same before it and differ at it; their records before it are one, so no learner, whatever it is given, is right on both; a learner right from T on, on every run from a configuration, leaves no two of those runs parting from T on.<br>两个运行在某步之前所识相同、在该步不同，即在该步分开；两者在该步之前的记录是同一个，所以没有学习者，无论被给予什么，在两者上都对；在从一个配置出发的每个运行上从 T 起都对的学习者，使这些运行在 T 之后不分开。 (`Becoming.Parting.PartAt`, `Becoming.Parting.RightAt`, `Becoming.Parting.course`, `Becoming.Parting.not_right_on_both`, `Becoming.Parting.not_parting_of_right`)
2. With the registered values decided, no two runs from a configuration part exactly where all of them register one course.<br>所识的值可判定时，从一个配置出发没有两个运行分开，恰当它们所识的是同一历程。 (`Becoming.Parting.Unparted`, `Becoming.Parting.unparted_iff`)
3. Not parting is kept along runs: a run up to a step joined to any run from where it is at that step is a run from its start, so every configuration a run from an unparted configuration reaches is unparted.<br>不分开沿运行保持：把一个运行到某步为止，与从它在那一步所在处出发的任一运行相连，得到从其起点出发的运行，所以从不分开的配置出发的运行所到之处也不分开。 (`Becoming.Parting.after`, `Becoming.Parting.before`, `Becoming.Parting.joinAt`, `Becoming.Parting.joinAt_before`, `Becoming.Parting.joinAt_after`, `Becoming.Parting.Unparted.along`)
4. On a run from an unparted configuration held by a list of N configurations the registered course has at most N states, and the learner by the least bound, given nothing, is right from N + N − 1 on; for N ≥ 2 no learner is right at N + N − 2 on every such run of every process of N configurations.<br>从不分开的配置出发、被 N 个配置的列表所持的运行，其所识的历程至多有 N 个状态，以最小的界读记录的学习者不被给予什么，从 N + N − 1 起每步都对；N ≥ 2 时没有学习者在每个这样的运行上于 N + N − 2 都对。 (`Becoming.Parting.course_statesBelow`, `Becoming.Parting.leastBound_right`, `Becoming.Parting.rest_earliest_runs`)
5. A determined process with one move parts nowhere, so determined laws are the instance; a branching that does not show in what is registered parts nowhere either.<br>一个动作的确定过程处处不分开，所以确定的律是实例；分支不显于所识者也不分开。 (`Becoming.Parting.states_agree`, `Becoming.Parting.unparted_of_determined`, `Becoming.Parting.free_unparted_const`)
6. Under free branching every course is a run's course; after every record two runs with that record part, every learner is not right at the next step on one of them, and one run makes it wrong at every step.<br>自由分支下每个历程都是一个运行的历程；每个记录之后，两个有这一记录的运行分开，每个学习者在其中一个上于下一步不对，且有一个运行使它每步都不对。 (`Becoming.Parting.free`, `Becoming.Parting.freeRun`, `Becoming.Parting.freeRun_course`, `Becoming.Parting.free_parts_after`, `Becoming.Parting.free_open`, `Becoming.Parting.free_never_right`)
7. Free branching on two values is held by a list of two configurations, and one of its runs has a registered course with no bound on its states.<br>两个值上的自由分支被两个配置的列表所持，其中一个运行所识的历程没有状态数的界。 (`Becoming.Parting.free_held`, `Becoming.Parting.free_unbounded`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom. What each law needs is written into it: a run held by a list and an unparted start; unparted_iff, leastBound_right and free_open need the registered values decided; free_never_right, free_held and free_unbounded are stated on two values (Bool).<br>不加公理。各律所写者写在定理中：运行被列表所持，起点的配置不分开；unparted_iff、leastBound_right 与 free_open 要所识的值可判定；free_never_right、free_held 与 free_unbounded 陈述在两个值（Bool）上。
- The learner reads the values registered at configurations; moves register only where the registration reads them (for instance, where a configuration carries its last move).<br>学习者读配置所识的值；动作只在识读它们时被识（例如配置带着它的上一个动作）。

## Does not show / 未表明

- The converse with a learner given the world: that some learner is right at a step on every run from a configuration exactly where no two of its runs part there.<br>反方向：给定世界的学习者在每个运行上于某步都对，恰当从那个配置出发的运行在那一步不分开。
- The rest step where runs part only before some step and never after it.<br>运行只在某步之前分开、此后不分开时的静止之步。
- A bound on configurations bounds no course where runs part.<br>配置数的界在运行分开之处不约束历程。 Witness: `Becoming.Parting.free_unbounded`.
- **Counterexample / 反例:** free_parts_after: after every record two runs of free branching with that record part; free_never_right: for every learner, the diagonal run of free branching makes it wrong at every step; free_unbounded: a run on two configurations whose course is no lasso and has no bound on its states.<br>free_parts_after：每个记录之后，自由分支上两个有这一记录的运行分开；free_never_right：对每个学习者，自由分支上的对角运行使它每步都不对；free_unbounded：两个配置上的一个运行，其历程不是任何套索，没有状态数的界。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Parting.lean)

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. 不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. 不含伦理谓词，不评价生起或消失。 · Stated for discrete steps. 按离散步骤陈述。 · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. 形式模型中的规律；与实际系统的对应是另一项责任。 · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026 and are adopted where the statement has their exact meaning (Ren, 12 October 2026); readings not marked as Ren's are decided by the AI on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, which Ren can reverse. 名称依 Ren 2026年10月10日的命名标准，在陈述有其确切意义处采用（Ren，2026年10月12日）；未注明属于 Ren 的读法，依 Ren 2026年10月15日的交托由 AI 决定，Ren 可以改动。

## Next / 下一步

For finite, decided processes, the learner given the world right at every step where runs do not part (the converse); the rest step where runs part only before some step.<br>对有限、已定的过程，给定世界的学习者在不分开之步都对（反方向）；只在某步之前分开时的静止之步。

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren, 15 October 2026: “"What this line doesn’t reach" is also worth doing”, with the core read as the whole covering all reality where things and changes exist, with zero axioms, and “if my earlier words are unreasonable, please keep note, not follow blindly”. The identification line (identification-where-bounded) is stated for determined laws; this states it for every process, determined laws being one case. Known result: no learner right on both at a parting is the indistinguishability argument. The AI's note: “the full "truth" can be derived, situationally” (12 October) holds for what is registered, as far as runs do not part; that every situation is bounded is not derived with no axiom. The AI's first reading, “at a parting the branch is settled only when taken”, is withdrawn; Ren, 16 October 2026: “the actual change depends on the situation … the situation makes it true”. Read so (the AI's reading of Ren's words, which Ren took the same day): at a parting, what the record and the supplied law leave open the situation fixes (weights-count-situations).<br>Ren 2026-10-15：“"What this line doesn’t reach" is also worth doing”，并说核心是覆盖有物与变化的全部实在、零公理者，且“if my earlier words are unreasonable, please keep note, not follow blindly”。辨识一线对确定的律陈述，这里对每个过程。已知：分开处无学习者两者都对是不可区分论证。AI 的注：2026-10-12 的“the full "truth" can be derived, situationally”对所识者成立，到运行不分开为止；每个情境都有界不由零公理推出。原先的 AI 读法“分开处的分支只在被走时定下”已撤回；Ren 2026-10-16：“the actual change depends on the situation … the situation makes it true”。读法（Ren 同日已取）：分开处记录与所给的律不固定的，由情境固定（weights-count-situations）。
